subject: IvoryHealth workspace provisioning & API-key cadence
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Kate Li <kate@ivoryhealth.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: IvoryHealth workspace provisioning & API-key cadence

Hi Kate —

Thanks again for the demo last week. To make the implementation handoff smooth, we want to confirm a few items so our implementation sprint can start next week. High level ask: provide admin contacts, SSO/KMS details (if you plan to integrate), and a short estimate of expected sustained qps and monthly token volume so we can seed the right instance and API keys.

Specifically:
- Primary admin for invites & role approvals (name + email)
- SSO: SAML or OIDC? Do you have metadata we can consume?
- KMS: will you provide a customer-managed key (AWS KMS / GCP CMEK)?
- Initial projects/namespaces you'd like us to create (examples: "ivory-stage", "ivory-prod")
- Number of seats for admin/dev/qa and who needs which role (we'll provide a template)
- Any procurement/contract contacts we should CC for reserved capacity setup

I've attached a short CSV with the scope fields we typically ask for (ivory_onboarding_scope.csv) and a sample role matrix. If you can reply with the admin contact and SSO metadata this week, Jonas will schedule the implementation kickoff with your infra team.

Thanks — looking forward to getting you live.

—
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
+1 415-555-0124

Attachments: ivory_onboarding_scope.csv
From: Kate Li <kate@ivoryhealth.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 28 Mar 2027 12:04:00 -0700
Subject: Re: IvoryHealth workspace provisioning & API-key cadence

Hi Monica — thanks, and great to meet you earlier.

Primary admin will be Tom Eriksen (tom.eriksen@ivoryhealth.com) from our platform team — copying him here. We'll use SAML 2.0 for SSO and Tom will attach the metadata file. For KMS we're planning to use AWS KMS under our account (we'll share the key ARN).

For initial environment naming, please provision: ivory-staging, ivory-production. Seats: 2 admins, 3 devs, 1 QA. Estimated steady-state qps for text generation ~ 3 r/s (peaks up to 12 r/s), token volume ~ 12M tokens/month to start — may increase after pilot.

Procurement: contracts@ivoryhealth.com for contract routing.

Appreciate you and Jonas coordinating the kickoff next week.

Best,
Kate
VP Product, Ivory Health

Thanks Tom — and hi Kate. I'm the implementation lead for this onboarding. Quick runbook/comments below: 

1) Timeline
- Day 0 (kickoff): confirm admin users + SSO metadata, exchange KMS details
- Day 1: we create two namespaces (ivory-staging, ivory-production), seed one short-lived API key per environment for initial smoke tests
- Day 3: run traffic test, adjust concurrency/backpressure settings, provide long-lived keys if requested

2) API key cadence
- Initial seeding: short-lived keys (24h) for smoke tests on Day 1; if smoke tests pass we'll issue scoped long-lived keys (rotate every 90 days) and provide key IDs for audit
- Option: we can integrate with your KMS for envelope encryption of keys and rotate via Vault if you prefer

3) Role matrix & invite plan — Laura (CS Ops) will send a template for invites and propose an invite schedule (we typically stagger admin invites then dev invites).

Security check: with your qps the default staging sizing is fine; we'll monitor token consumption during the pilot. Please share any IP allowlist entries if you have them.

I'll schedule a 30-minute kickoff for Wed 31 Mar 2027 10:00am PT — does that work?

—
Jonas Weber
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.ai
